evaluation.interpretation: Retrospective listed/not-listed snapshot classification; not exploitation probability or future inclusion.
evaluation.previous_test: Previously observed; never exported, trained or scored by this adapter or smoke.
evaluation.source_policy_review: Automated engineering review and focused tests; independent semantic annotation remains pending. Approved here only for adapter/integration smoke.

smoke.sampling: Seeded sampling within previous role/label; approximately retain positive fraction, at least two of each class. Integration only, not representative performance evidence.
smoke.selection: No model or threshold selection; four fixed logistic fits, plus constant. All outputs reported.

cache_policy: No TPG or embedding cache is loaded or rebuilt. Future reuse requires exact accepted document text/source and matching extraction/embedding identities.
predictor_exclusions: EPSS values/metadata, all catalogue-derived fields and transformations, quarantine reasons/counts, CVE identifiers and roles as numerical features. CVE/role exist only for joining and assertions.
